print-file.subject: Your FAN LIFE print is ready
print-file.title:
Your print,
ready to hang.
print-file.line: It was made for you alone, from the FAN LIFE archive of the game. The full-size file is waiting behind the button below.
print-file.note: Full size: 3600 × 4800 px, a sharp print up to A3.
tips: Ask the print shop for 30 × 40 cm or A3: the file is made for that shape.
Choose matte or satin paper of 200 g or more; the inks look their best on it.
Print at 100% with no cropping, so the frame stays whole.
